glossary.action: Policy to apply to the packet.
glossary.custom_routes_propagation_enabled: Defines whether the VPC advertises custom routes between its Private Networks.
glossary.default_policy: Action to take for packets which do not match any rules.
glossary.default_route_propagation_enabled: Defines whether default v4 and v6 routes are propagated for this Private Network.
glossary.dhcp_enabled: Defines whether managed DHCP is enabled for this Private Network.
glossary.dst_port_high: Ending port of the destination port range to which this rule applies (inclusive).
glossary.dst_port_low: Starting port of the destination port range to which this rule applies (inclusive).
glossary.enable_routing: Enable routing between Private Networks in the VPC.
glossary.enable_transitivity: Enable packets from peered VPCs to transit through this VPC.
glossary.has_object_storage_private_access: Defines whether this Private Network is enabled for Object Storage private access.
glossary.is_default: Defines whether the VPC is the default one for its Project.
glossary.is_ipv6: Whether this rule applies to IPv4 or IPv6 traffic.
glossary.is_read_only: Defines whether the route can be modified or deleted by the user.
glossary.nexthop_resource_id: ID of the nexthop resource. (UUID format)
glossary.nexthop_resource_ip: IP of the local resource to redirect ingress traffic to. (IP address)
glossary.nexthop_vpc_connector_id: ID of the nexthop VPC connector. (UUID format)
glossary.object_storage_private_access_enabled: Defines whether the Object Storage private access is enabled for the VPC.
glossary.page: Page number to return, from the paginated results.
glossary.peer_info: Peer info of target VPC. Available when status is Peered.
glossary.private_network_count: Number of Private Networks within this VPC.
glossary.private_network_id: Private Network the subnet belongs to. (UUID format)
glossary.private_network_ids: IDs of the Private Networks associated with the Object Storage private access.
glossary.protocol: Protocol to which this rule applies.
glossary.routing_enabled: Defines whether the VPC routes traffic between its Private Networks.
glossary.src_port_high: Ending port of the source port range to which this rule applies (inclusive).
glossary.src_port_low: Starting port of the source port range to which this rule applies (inclusive).
glossary.subnet_ids: Subnet IDs to filter for. Only subnets matching the specified IDs will be returned.
glossary.target_vpc_id: VPC with which the VPC connector is peered (target VPC). (UUID format)
glossary.transitivity_enabled: Defines whether the VPC allows packets from peered VPCs to transit through.

operations.description: List existing Private Networks in the specified region. By default, the Private Networks returned in the list are ordered by creation date in ascending order, though this can be modified via the order_by field.

parameters.description: The region you want to target

parameters.description: Sort order of the returned Private Networks.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return, from the paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of Private Networks to return per page.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name to filter for. Only Private Networks with names containing this string will be returned.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to filter for. Only Private Networks with one or more matching tags will be returned.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: Organization ID to filter for. Only Private Networks belonging to this Organization will be returned. (UUID format)

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID to filter for. Only Private Networks belonging to this Project will be returned. (UUID format)

parameters.name: private_network_ids
parameters.description: Private Network IDs to filter for. Only Private Networks with one of these IDs will be returned.

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: VPC ID to filter for. Only Private Networks belonging to this VPC will be returned. (UUID format)

parameters.name: dhcp_enabled
parameters.description: DHCP status to filter for. When true, only Private Networks with managed DHCP enabled will be returned.

parameters.name: object_storage_private_access_enabled
parameters.description: Filter by whether Object Storage private access is enabled. When set, only matching Private Networks will be returned.
